name: Expected Return Calculator
meta_title: Expected Return Calculator with Standard Deviation
meta_description: Calculate the probability-weighted expected return of an investment across scenarios, plus its variance and standard deviation.
subtitle: Enter possible outcomes with their probabilities to work out the expected return of an investment and how widely the results spread, measured by variance and standard deviation.

The expected return is a probability-weighted average of the scenarios, not a forecast of what will happen; the actual return will be one of the scenarios. Standard deviation measures how far the outcomes spread around that average.
